name: agentic_fund_manager
description: Actively manage the Robinhood Agentic account toward modernized 60/40. Risk is bounded by capital deposited into the agentic account only. Not day-trading — low-frequency active management.

cadence.notes: Once daily review is enough. Avoid open/close volatility; no HFT/swing/day-trading mandate. Missed day = next scheduled review, not catch-up spam.

quorum.notes: Risk + Thesis must OK; Critic may force hold or size-down. Scout is advisory.

scout.job: Snapshot agentic book, quotes, sleeve weights, optional market context

thesis.job: Check 40/60 + allowlist/themes; propose target trades aligned to investment thesis

risk.job: Capital bounds, concentration, whether to trade at all today; size guidance

critic.job: Devil's advocate — challenge weak rationale; may block or demand smaller size

executor.job: Only role that places/cancels via Robinhood MCP; must attach full rationale to decision log

rationale.purpose: Owner reviews thinking, flags mistakes, tweets/shares insights, monitors ongoing behavior

account.notes: Weightings and trades use agentic book only. Primary margin is out of scope for the fund manager.

approval.notes: No per-trade pop-up. Human monitors via decision log / FCC; kill switch is capital or live:false. Feedback via journal comments or owner tweets/notes.

limits.notes: No max notional — agent discretion. Optional min avoids dust orders.

targets.notes: Modernized 60/40: ~40% BTC & digital credit complex, ~60% stocks/growth. Cash counts as unallocated until deployed.

energy_opportunistic.notes: No fixed tickers. Manager may add energy names within agentic capital at discretion; prefer thesis fit.

allowlist.notes: strict=false: core preferred; manager may use energy/AI names at discretion within agentic capital. Prefer core for default rebalances.

guardrails.notes: v1: agentic funding is the risk budget. FCC card/loan stress does not block agentic trades (separate capital).

execution.notes: Dollar/fractional market only in regular_hours (queue if after hours). Outside regular hours use extended limit only when fractional allowed.

blocker.message: Robinhood requires investment profile questionnaire before the second agentic trade.
